issues_found.problem: DGM discussion did not delimit what can actually self-modify, leaving fixed outer search and frozen weights implicit.
issues_found.evidence: DGM local v3 §3, PDF pp.4-5 explicitly excludes archive maintenance/parent selection from modifiable code.
issues_found.fix: Added frozen-base and fixed-outer-loop boundaries, separating structural self-reference from proven recursive acceleration.

issues_found.problem: Lecture transition between original AlphaGo and AlphaGo Zero was not explained.
issues_found.evidence: L1 p.51 describes AlphaGo expert imitation; p.53 describes Zero without human gameplay data.
issues_found.fix: Explained the two training routes and human-designed rules/search remaining in Zero.

issues_found.problem: The rising V(context) figure was left without an explicit semantic boundary.
issues_found.evidence: L1 p.66 defines V as expected external reward from context; rising plot expresses an objective.
issues_found.fix: Defined expectation and clarified that adding tokens is not a monotonic value guarantee.

issues_found.problem: Separate concept definitions omitted the containment and conditional arrows in the lecture diagram.
issues_found.evidence: L1 p.74: AI for AI Research inside Discovery; RSI enabled when improved AI performs research; continual gains must persist in improver.
issues_found.fix: Added these diagram relationships with their conceptual scope.

issues_found.problem: Baseline formula introduced G_t without defining reward-to-go; Actor–Critic discussion lacked a followable bridge from rewards to advantages/value targets.
issues_found.fix: Defined fixed reward/undiscounted derivation, reward-to-go, TD residual, masked truncated GAE, stopped value target, terminal handling; supplied and checked a two-step hand calculation.

issues_found.problem: LOO formula and quoted 53.0% ARC figure omitted important actual loss and model/pipeline conditions.
issues_found.evidence: TTT PDF pp.3-7, §3.2, §4.2-4.6 and Table1: demonstration losses, 1B/80-task ablations, 8B full set, 47.1% own fine-tuned model and 53.0% BARC checkpoint.
issues_found.fix: Explained output loss choices, prior synthetic fine-tuning, augmented inference/voting, 47.1 versus 53.0 setup distinction.

issues_found.problem: Existing caveat about sequence/local KL lacked the actual source convention and an executable example; default SDFT forward KL still lacked an explicit update contract.
issues_found.evidence: GKD §3.1 p.4 freezes sampling; SDFT v2 p.4 prefers forward KL/EMA; Appendix A.1 p.16 labels local sequence estimators biased; Algorithm1 p.20 defines EMA coefficient.
issues_found.fix: Added sampling stop-gradient, explicit local forward-KL/soft-label gradient P-Q with numeric example, EMA new-student coefficient convention, full fixed-teacher sequence return-to-go gradient, and a four-sequence finite-difference check.

issues_found.problem: Near-perfect KL/forgetting claim lacked the strength and population of the actual fits.
issues_found.evidence: RAZOR §4 PDF p.6 reports toy R²≈0.96 and LLM R²≈0.71; Fig.11 on p.23.
issues_found.fix: Specified the two settings, explained R² as explained fitted variation, and rejected interpreting it as probability/correctness or a universal safe threshold.

issues_found.problem: Lecture negative-example/on-policy argument was discussed as a proposed control without reporting the actual key four-condition experiment.
issues_found.evidence: G6 pp.33-34 and RAZOR §5.1 pp.7-8 compare GRPO, 1-0 REINFORCE, SFT, SimPO on Science Q&A.
issues_found.fix: Added the four conditions and observed grouping, with scope and probability-coupling caveat.

issues_found.problem: SDFT experiment setting was too abstract to prevent mixing the paper protocol with the separate verl tutorial or interpreting reward-free as supervision-free.
issues_found.evidence: SDFT v2 Appendix A.1-A.2/B.1-B.3 pp.16-20; §5 pp.10-11.
issues_found.fix: Added full-parameter H200/TRL/single-rollout setup, selection/decoding/seeds, demonstration provenance, regex versus execution scoring, medical evaluator, article+answer ablation, 2.5x FLOPs/4x time, and teacher phrase artifacts.
